entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: First of all, then, I exhort [that] supplications, prayers, intercessions, [and] giving of thanks be made for all men,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: for kings and all who are in authority, so that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: For this [is] good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: who will have all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: For God [is] one, and [there is] one Mediator between God and man, [the] Man Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: who gave Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: To this I am ordained a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth in Christ, I do not lie), a teacher of [the] nations, in faith and truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: Therefore, I desire that men pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: In the same way also, I desire that women adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and sensibleness, not [adorned] with braiding, or gold, or pearls, or costly clothing,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: but with good works, which becomes women professing godliness.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: But I do not allow a woman to teach, or to exercise authority [over] a man, but to be in silence.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: And Adam was not deceived, but [the] woman being deceived was in the transgression.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: But she will be kept safe through childbearing, if they continue in faith and love and holiness with sensibleness.
